nodes.speaker: Cole
nodes.text: Wage crates, stamped COPPERHEAD. All here. And underneath... a strongbox with a big gold V on it. Vane's private stash, riding along for company.

choices.text: Take the wages. Only the wages.
The wages... and Vane's shiny box too.

nodes.speaker: Cole
nodes.text: Take only what was taken. The V stays. Might leave the box a little disappointed in its owner, though.

nodes.speaker: Cole
nodes.text: ...Rosa's going to give me the look. The one with the eyebrow. Worth it? Ask me tomorrow.
